BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to improving educational opportunities forlow-income students; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that more thanforty percent of children from highincome families received abachelor's degree or higher within five years of high schoolgraduation, compared with only six percent of those in the lowestincome group. Opening educational opportunities for these students canaddress and correct this disparity. Effective mentoring programs,along with financial assistance, prepare these lowincome students tosucceed and achieve their educational goals. (2) In order to broaden higher education opportunities, to theextent funds are specifically appropriated for this purpose, thelegislature supports the Washington state achievers' scholarshipprogram. This program: (a) Provides mentoring to ensure academicsupport is available to students while in high school, encouragescollege enrollment, and gives assistance when enrolled in college; (b)identifies and reduces financial barriers to college for talented, low p. 1 SSB 5759income students; and (c) leverages private funding for higher educationfinancial assistance.
